summary: Comprehensive architectural and UX redesign plan for EUCMD Young Adults web application. Establishes an 'Editorial Warm & Modern' visual identity with warm stone tones, refined serif display typography, asymmetric editorial hero with a split weekly gathering schedule card and authentic community imagery, zero-pill metadata discipline, and structured layout rhythm while preserving all existing backend integrations, authentication, database stores, search palette, event RSVPs, and compliance endpoints.
